strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Look for price to break support or resistance, fake out, and then reverse in the opposite direction. The executable entry is placed at the candle that made the liquidity grab; enter long on a bullish grab or short on a bearish grab.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss beyond the liquidity grab and take profit at a recent swing high/low or the next major extremity, aiming to capture the impulsive reversal move.

strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal_with_divergence_confluence
strategies.entry_summary: Take the same liquidity-grab reversal entry, but only when momentum divergence confirms the setup: price makes a liquidity grab while the oscillator makes the opposite higher-high/lower-low behavior. Enter in the direction of the reversal once both signals align.
strategies.exit_summary: Use the same stop beyond the grab and take profit at the next swing extreme; the divergence is a filter/confluence, not a separate exit rule.

strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal_with_higher_timeframe_support_filter
strategies.entry_summary: Use the liquidity-grab reversal entry only when it occurs at a meaningful higher-timeframe support or resistance level. The trader drops to a lower timeframe for the grab/entry, but first checks the higher timeframe to confirm the location is at the top or bottom of the larger range.
strategies.exit_summary: Exit the lower-timeframe reversal at the usual nearby swing extreme; the higher-timeframe check is a location filter for improving the reversal entry, not a different exit method.
